entries.summary: Complete: all 195 chapters are full. The last ten add the Bible map, the Canon lineage graph, fifty hard questions with answers, interview and portfolio guides, and the update process, with 30 quiz questions.

Deepened 13 chapters: Books 7 and 19 are now complete in full, and Book 0 gains the AI engineer role and mental models. Adds a dated state-of-the-art snapshot, lineage, open-problem and skill maps, test-time scaling and task-horizon charts, and 39 quiz questions.

Deepened 13 chapters: Books 1 and 8 are now complete in full, and Book 7 gains data strategy, labeling and synthetic data. Adds precision-recall, image-token and Cohen’s kappa calculators, backpropagation, gridworld, contrastive and diffusion steppers, and 39 quiz questions.

Deepened 13 chapters: Books 4 and 18 are now complete in full, including all twelve reference blueprints, and Book 1 gains linear algebra, probability and optimization. Adds cost-per-correct, back-of-envelope and entropy calculators, a public-lessons matrix and 39 quiz questions.

Deepened 13 chapters: Book 3 is now complete in full, and Book 4 gains frontier families, reasoning models, small models and specialist models. Adds training-memory and LoRA calculators, a GRPO stepper, an RLHF pipeline, a model-families matrix and 39 quiz questions.

Deepened 13 chapters: Books 2 and 13 are now complete in full, and Book 3 gains pretraining data and scaling laws. Adds parameter-count, framework-scoring and compute calculators, FlashAttention tiling and MoE routing steppers, RoPE and attention-memory charts, and 39 quiz questions.

Deepened 13 chapters: Books 10 and 16 are now complete in full, and Book 13 gains the landscape map, provider and agent SDKs, orchestration frameworks and low-code builders. Adds a document review-cost calculator, voice latency and incident walkthroughs, and 39 quiz questions. Fixes charts so explicit axis bounds are respected.

Deepened 13 chapters: Book 15 is now complete in full, and Book 16 gains everything except incidents and on-call. Adds token-cost and GPU-capacity calculators, an API-versus-self-hosting break-even chart, an accelerator comparison, a reference architecture, streaming event and eval-gate walkthroughs, and 39 quiz questions.

Deepened 13 chapters: Book 17 is now complete in full, and Book 15 gains inference fundamentals through disaggregated serving. Adds roofline and speculative-decoding explorers, a serving-memory calculator, a continuous-batching stepper, a regulation timeline with 11 new Genesis events, a safety-frameworks matrix and 39 quiz questions.

Deepened 13 chapters: Book 14 is now complete in full, and Book 17 gains threat modeling, secure agent design, jailbreaks and misuse, and supply chain security. Adds A/B sample-size and eval sample-size calculators, a dataset coverage heatmap, a dual LLM sequence, eval-recipe and STRIDE-for-AI matrices and 39 quiz questions.

Deepened 13 chapters: Books 5 and 6 are now complete in full. Adds an nDCG explorer, a prompt-caching savings calculator, a constrained-decoding stepper, a model-prompting matrix, 39 quiz questions and 23 Lexicon terms.

Deepened 13 chapters: Book 11 is now complete in full, and Book 6 gains ingestion and parsing, embeddings, vector search, vector databases, hybrid retrieval, query understanding, reranking and advanced RAG. Adds a sandbox-isolation matrix, an HNSW search stepper, a reranking latency calculator, 39 quiz questions and 26 Lexicon terms.

Deepened 12 chapters: Book 12 is now complete in full, and Book 11 gains what a harness is, the Claude Code case study, the coding-harness landscape, skills and plugins, and working with coding agents. Adds an MCP version matrix, 36 quiz questions and 22 Lexicon terms.

Deepened 13 chapters: Book 9 is now complete in full, and Book 12 gains why protocols, client features and round trips, transports, authorization and security. Adds an autonomy-dial explorer, 39 quiz questions, 30 Lexicon terms and 5 Genesis events.

First complete release: all 195 chapters on the map, 17 flagships in full with interactive visuals, the Lexicon, Genesis, quizzes for every Book, learning paths, playgrounds, calculators, wizards, matrices and Commandments.
Checkpoint: the engine, every feature page, and Books 0 and 9.
